pokedexEntries.bk: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

pokedexEntries.wh: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

pokedexEntries.x: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

pokedexEntries.or: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

pokedexEntries.y: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

pokedexEntries.as: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

pokedexEntries.sw: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.

pokedexEntries.sh: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

pokedexEntries.sc: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

pokedexEntries.vi: Rather than rely on their strength, they master moves that make good use of centrifugal force to swing around concrete.
